FILM 02 CALCULUS

Integrals

Riemann rectangles becoming continuous area under f(x) = x² from 0 to 2. Follow the convergence from 4 to 10, 50, and 200 rectangles toward 8/3 ≈ 2.667.

▶ ~71s Runtime Watch Film
FILM 03 COMPLEX ANALYSIS

Complex Numbers

Multiplication as 2D rotation and scaling in the Argand plane. See why i² = −1 is a 180° flip, multiply z = 1 + i by i, and explore polar angle addition.

▶ ~70s Runtime Watch Film
FILM 04 LINEAR ALGEBRA

Linear Algebra

Matrices transforming 2D space. Discover why most vectors tilt while eigenvectors along invariant axes satisfy Av = λv without rotating.

▶ ~74s Runtime Watch Film

Probability

The Law of Large Numbers converging coin tosses from 10 to 10,000 flips, and Bayes' Theorem demystifying the 15.4% medical test paradox.
